text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking through the gymnasium looking for equipment to use for training—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. It's 'wanting to search'.
However, there is no... "trajectory"...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it truly seems ottava... no, quindicesima to loco.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yet there is no reason to despair, astronauta.
Let me hear it. I will certainly sense it for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as that question crossed my mind—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that you over there, amico?
Don't be shy, come on out.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that you over there, amica?
Don't be shy, come on out.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Truth be told, Universe-san can't seem to recall the title of a certain song. I'm lending her a helping hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Sounds of Earth explained the situation.
'If we don't know it, we can simply look it up on the internet—'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, searching requires audio.
And so, they had come up with the idea of recreating the song based on clues and recording it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If "analysis" is viable—
I shall perform "requesting".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: That melodia just now was... like this, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
!
"METI"...! It is 'similar'.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Bene! Then let us proceed.
Next, tell me the rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ho... like this, then.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――!
It is "SASA"!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean I'm correct?
Fufu, I'm beginning to understand the sound you seek!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now we should be able to reproduce it—
Come, suoniamo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(*CHAKA-CHAKA-CHAKA-CHAKA!!!!
CHAKA-CHAKA-CHAKA-CHAKA!!!!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At tremendous volume, the sound of maracas echoed throughout the entire gymnasium—!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Amico, won't you record this for us?
We shall cast it forth into the vast ocean of the internet!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Amica, could you record this for me?
Let us cast it out into the vast ocean of the internet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Shaka-shaka, chaka-chaka!!!!
Chaka-poko, don-chan!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An overwhelmingly intense rhythm, a dramatic melody.
Wondering if such a song could truly exist, I searched the internet using the recorded sound—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "1 matching track found."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Sfera! That is a "match"!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...The "disconnection" has vanished.
"Gratitude" to you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Heh, the pleasure is mine.
It was an honor to be of service, enigmatic astronauta.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sounds of Earth managed to reproduce the melody from mere fragments of clues. Only someone with her razor-sharp artistic sensibilities could pull off such a feat... perhaps.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, there's a song I've been wondering about...
Come to think of it, there's a song I've been wondering about...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sounds of Earth managed to reproduce the melody from mere fragments of clues. Only someone with her razor-sharp artistic sensibilities could pull off such a feat... perhaps.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, there's a song I've been wondering about...
Come to think of it, there's a song I've been wondering about...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I too had a song I wanted to recall.
Clinging to a sliver of hope, I hummed the part I could remember.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I see... Perhaps like this?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then let us cast this out into the great ocean as well.
Will you sing along? Now, a due!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative.
...It brought "tranquility."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed—
It truly puts one in a comodo e adagio mood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was an utterly unique form of communication, but the two managed to understand one another perfectly. Watching them filled me with warmth as well.
